propositions: Close must run a separately attested plan-review gate before completion verification when require_plan_review_for_close=true, blocking closure if the plan or pinned upstream changed during execution
The CLOSE profile intentionally disables code freshness checks but enforces signature, registry currency, own-material drift, phase compatibility, and configured pin enforcement
A generic pre_status_check callback hook must execute inside the existing write lock after structural checks and before STATUS append, catching race changes between precheck and lock
Unexpected local exceptions during plan-review gate evaluation must fail closed with verdict unavailable and emit no traceback
Close must preserve all existing exemptions (bugs, session logs, code reviews, identities, idea→closed) and force-close bypass behavior exactly as claim gate
Configuration must default to false to preserve byte-for-byte equivalence of existing close paths when not enabled
